title: AUTO-JOG AND TEAMMATE DOWN IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps callout and only a short caps detail, never an explaining sentence. The review of the fifth batch of raid text found four lines still written as sentences. The auto-jog details read Then tap [CAPS] to auto-jog. and Tap [CAPS] or move to stop. and now read [CAPS] AUTO-JOG and [CAPS] OR MOVE TO CANCEL. The TEAMMATE DOWN detail read Moth needs a revive. and now reads REVIVE MOTH, the verb the revive prompt at his body uses. The Peddler plate beside a crate not yet searched read THE PEDDLER (search the crate first) and now reads THE PEDDLER, a middle dot, SEARCH CRATE FIRST, like every other nameplate. The locked door second line Needs the Archive Key stays: the raid text design names it as the sentence case second line of a prompt.
now: The auto-jog lines, the TEAMMATE DOWN detail and the Peddler plate now read as short caps callouts.
